notes.zh: 补全中英文 Outlook / Microsoft 365 邮箱接入指南，增加复杂度提醒及完整20步：Azure免费注册与银行卡验证、默认目录、应用ID、公共客户端流、IMAP委托权限、取令牌和失效后重取；解释AADSTS50020/50058及自动转发替代方案。
notes.en: Completes the Chinese and English Outlook / Microsoft 365 setup guide with a difficulty notice and 20 steps covering Azure Free signup and card verification, the default directory, application ID, public-client flows, delegated IMAP permissions, obtaining tokens and renewing expired access tokens. Explains AADSTS50020/50058 and forwarding alternatives.
